milestones.claim: Add digest-bound playbook_candidate_ingest wrapper for DONE/story seed to candidate conversion.
milestones.doneMeans: playbook_candidate_ingest --apply creates inert candidate playbooks from eligible done-experience seeds and reports observeDigest, manifestDigest, created/skipped counts.

milestones.claim: Wire post-DONE settlement to best-effort candidate ingestion for the completed story.
milestones.doneMeans: A simulated post-DONE settlement records learning health and attempts story-scoped candidate ingestion without blocking DONE.

milestones.claim: Preserve candidate inertness and evidence-based activation boundary.
milestones.doneMeans: Candidate ingestion writes no helped outcome rows, no auto-activation rows, and runtime consumption verification keeps candidates out of active guidance.

milestones.claim: Document and surface automatic seed-to-candidate ingestion distinctly from activation/backfill.
milestones.doneMeans: Docs and status output name playbook_candidate_ingest, DONE candidate ingestion, default-on/opt-out boundary, and gateEvidence=false authority limits.
